authoringMethod: Record production authority and mutation boundary before creative work.
Extract shipped evidence and adjacent-scene continuity.
Frame story intent and player agency before score or cinematography treatment.
Generate score and cinematography first treatments independently.
Exchange structured peer notes and preserve dissent.
Freeze and sign one shared scene contract with named synchronization anchors.
Integrate shared runtime files through one patch lane.
Capture mechanical, visual, audio, accessibility, quality-tier, and performance evidence.
Run fresh independent domain and blind reviewers before cohesion judgement.
Compile one canonical defect register, then route bounded repair; any creative-intent change reopens the full contract and three-signature cycle before evidence is regenerated.
Require human taste and a separate publish decision where configured.
Record lessons that survive without chat history.
nonNegotiables: Do not let a director approve its own implementation.
Do not let directors race mutations to shared timeline or rendering files.
Do not leak canon or intent to blind reviewers.
Do not flatten material dissent into generic compromise.
Do not advance beyond current production authority.
Do not publish from a director, patch, verifier, or judge role.
Do not approve beauty from headless evidence alone.
Do not accept thin treatments, unresolved blocking notes, partial scorecards, or missing lessons.
